title: ArtifactGenerationRequest
description: Contract between the Governor (Copilot declarative agent) and Generation Engine v2. Domains follow Arti-Generator spec Section 10. Deliberately strict: closed enums, no additionalProperties, exact patterns. Governor drift must surface as SchemaValidationError, never as silent acceptance. Schema-valid does not mean generation-valid: registry sync, lifecycle transition legality, clause hashes, and placeholder resolution are enforced by the engine's semantic validation layers after schema validation passes.

schemaVersion.description: AGR contract version. The engine rejects mismatches (ConfigurationError) rather than best-effort parsing.

documentId.description: Must already be issued by the ID Registrar and present in the ID Registry in Draft status. The engine verifies registry state (RegistrySyncError on mismatch); it never mints IDs. Pattern encodes valid category/code pairings; engine additionally verifies the embedded code matches artifactType.

approvalStatus.description: Status this generation targets. New artifacts must be Draft. Any transition is validated against vocabularies.json transitions and current registry state (LifecycleTransitionError).

client.description: Null only for MST and internal-only artifacts (client-scoping rule, Spec 5.5).

owner.description: Accountable role or team, typically Registry Owner.

audience.description: Plain-English intended reader. Client context lives here and in the filename, never in the Document ID.

reviewDate.description: ISO 8601. Null permitted in Draft ('to be set on Approved'). Required at promotion. Must be at or before the category default interval unless reviewDateOverride is present.

approvedBy.description: Documentation owner sign-off is required for any interval longer than the category default (Spec 5.6).

executionId.description: Correlates the generated artifact, its logs, and its validation report back to the Governor session. Operator-assigned if the Governor cannot mint one.

placeholderMap.description: Canonical token to resolved value. Keys must match the placeholder token pattern and, for known tokens, the canonical form in placeholder-dictionary.json. Values of null mean intentionally-retained-for-client-completion (permitted in Draft only for Client-Facing artifacts).

title.description: Must match the artifact type's sectionSchema title exactly, in order. Engine rejects missing, extra, or reordered sections (ContentValidation).

descriptorLine.description: Optional single italic gray intro line. One maximum per section.

approvedNarrativeInputs.description: Identifiers of human-approved free-text inputs. Narrative without an approval reference is not evidence.

dependencies.description: Stable-identifier references, never filename-only strings (Arti-Generator 13.2). blocking=true dependencies that cannot be resolved fail generation or promotion per policy (DependencyResolutionError).

stylingProfile.description: Pins the style-rules.json version this render must use.

mode.description: draft: style deviations and unresolved client-completion placeholders downgrade to warnings; controlled-document violations still fail closed. promotion: everything blocks. There is no mode in which a missing or invalid Document Control Header produces output.

warningThreshold.description: Optional cap; exceeding it fails the run even in draft mode.

internalOnly.description: Marks a block as an internal-only note (remove-before-client-use). QA-SF-09 fails any internalOnly block in a client-facing artifact at promotion; internally-classified artifacts may retain it, and it renders per its blockType (author internal notes as an already-supported block, e.g. paragraph).

clauseId.description: Required when blockType=clauseInsertion. Engine inserts canonical text from clause-library.json and verifies the SHA-256; Governor-supplied clause text is ignored by design so paraphrase drift is structurally impossible.

aggregationSource.description: For an aggregationTable block: the config source to project. clauseLibrary is live; placeholderDictionary is reserved and fails closed until the PDX slice.

options.description: Four-option minimum per the v1.2 radio pattern. Renderer applies U+25CB glyph, indentation, and descriptor line; the Governor supplies only labels.
